## Import and Prepare Data

Loading data from:

```{r}
for (m in params$mif) cat(paste0(normalizePath(m), "\n"))
```

Using config:

```{r}
cat(params$cfg, "\n")
```

Based on:
https://scenario-evaluation-criteria.iamconsortium.org/2026.08.03/


```{r, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE, results = 'asis'}
# SCI evaluates cumulated geological carbon storage (2020-2100); if a scenario
# does not report the variable, calculate it from annual storage
cumVar <- "Carbon Management|Storage|Cumulated"
annVar <- "Carbon Management|Storage"

# import only the variables needed for the validation and for the cumulated
# storage calculation
neededVars <- unique(c(getConfig(params$cfg)$variable, annVar, cumVar))
data <- piamValidation:::importScenarioData(params$mif, variables = neededVars)

# model-scenario combinations missing the cumulated variable
missingCum <- data %>%
  filter(scenario != "historical") %>%
  distinct(model, scenario) %>%
  anti_join(filter(data, variable == cumVar), by = c("model", "scenario"))

if (nrow(missingCum) > 0) {
  cumData <- data %>%
    semi_join(missingCum, by = c("model", "scenario")) %>%
    filter(variable == annVar, period >= 2020, period <= 2100) %>%
    group_by(model, scenario, region) %>%
    arrange(period, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      # trapezoidal integration of annual storage, starting at 0 in 2020
      step = (period - lag(period)) * (value + lag(value)) / 2,
      value = cumsum(ifelse(is.na(step), 0, step)),
      variable = cumVar,
      unit = "Mt CO2") %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-step)

  if (nrow(cumData) == 0) {
    warning("Neither ``", cumVar, "`` nor ``", annVar, "`` found for some ",
            "scenarios, cumulated storage cannot be validated.")
  } else {
    cat(paste0("Variable ``", cumVar, "`` not reported by ",
               nrow(missingCum), " scenario(s), calculating it from ``",
               annVar, "``.\n"))
    data <- bind_rows(data, cumData)
  }
}
```

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE}
# Data Preparation
df <- validateScenarios(data, params$cfg, extraColors = params$extraColors)
df <- appendTooltips(df)
interact <- TRUE
```

## Validation

Currently, only threshold violations that are part of the historical vetting
lead to a scenario failing the SCI evaluation.

### Summary

```{r}
worst <- function(check, grey_label) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    any(check %in% c("red", "blue"))    ~ "high",
    any(check %in% c("yellow", "cyan")) ~ "medium",
    any(check == "grey")                ~ grey_label,
    TRUE                                ~ "ok")
}

sciSummary <- df %>%
  group_by(model, scenario) %>%
  summarise(
    `Historical Vetting` = ifelse(
      any(check %in% c("red", "blue") & critical == "yes"), "failed", "ok"),
    `Feasibility Concern` =
      worst(check[critical == "feasibility"], "not assigned"),
    `Sustainability Concern` =
      worst(check[critical == "sustainability"], "not assigned"),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(`SCI Evaluation` = ifelse(
    `Historical Vetting` == "ok", "passed", "excluded"))

colorCell <- function(x) kableExtra::cell_spec(
  x, background = dplyr::recode(x,
    ok = "#00845080", passed = "#00845080", medium = "#EFBB0F80",
    high = "#AA001480", failed = "#AA001480", excluded = "#AA001480",
    .default = "#80808080"))

sciSummary %>%
  mutate(across(-c(model, scenario), colorCell)) %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(escape = FALSE) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

## Heatmaps by Category

```{r, results='asis'}
legendColors <- c(green = "#008450", yellow = "#EFBB0F", red = "#AA0014",
                  cyan = "#7BD5F3", blue = "#4477AA", grey = "#808080")
legendLabels <- c(green =  "within thresholds",
                  yellow = "above threshold, medium concern",
                  red =    "above threshold, high concern / historical vetting failed",
                  cyan =   "below threshold, medium concern",
                  blue =   "below threshold, high concern / historical vetting failed",
                  grey =   "missing or infinite value")
# only show colors that actually appear in the data
usedColors <- intersect(names(legendColors), unique(df$check))
legendColors <- legendColors[usedColors]
items <- paste0(
  '<span style="display:inline-block;width:14px;height:14px;',
  'background-color:', legendColors,
  ';border:1px solid #ccc;margin-right:5px;vertical-align:middle;"></span> ',
  names(legendColors), " \u2013 ", legendLabels[names(legendColors)]
)
cat('<div style="margin-bottom:15px;">\n')
cat(paste(items, collapse = "<br>\n"))
cat("\n</div>\n")
```

```{r}
plotHeatmaps <- function(data, variables) {
  if (nrow(data) > 0) {
    if (interact) {  # interactive plots need to be collected in a tagList
      plot_list <- htmltools::tagList()
      for (i in 1:length(variables)) {
        plot_data <- filter(data, variable == variables[i])
        plot_list[[i]] <- validationHeatmap(plot_data)
      }
      plot_list
    } else {  # non-interactive plots can simply be printed in a loop
      for (i in 1:length(variables)) {
        p <- validationHeatmap(data, variables[i], interactive = interact)
        print(p)
      }
    }
  }
}
```


<!-- Historical Vetting -->

```{r, results='asis'}
# plot one heat map for each variable in this category
d <- filter(df, critical == "yes")  # SCI has critical variables = historical vetting
vars <- unique(d$variable)

if (nrow(d) > 0) {
  cat("### Historical Vetting\n\n")
  cat("Relative deviation to historical reference data.\n\n")
}
```

```{r}
plotHeatmaps(d, vars)
```
